## Critical Issue Found in Final Review

I've identified one more critical scene construction bug that was missed in previous rounds.

### The Problem

The command sequence places the red wall banner at `(10, 2, 15)`:
```
/setblock ~10 ~2 ~15 minecraft:red_wall_banner[facing=north]
```

Then later, the utility room entrance carves air through that exact position:
```
/fill ~9 ~0 ~15 ~10 ~2 ~15 minecraft:air
```
